references.text: Issachar's birth is described here, as the son of Jacob and Leah.
Zebulun's birth is described here, as the son of Jacob and Leah.
Benjamin's birth is described here, as the son of Jacob and Rachel.
A complete list of Jacob's twelve sons, including Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin.
The sons of Issachar and Zebulun who came to Egypt with Jacob.
The sons of Benjamin who came to Egypt with Jacob.
This reference confirms the genealogy of Israel's sons by comparing the original list with the revised overview in Chronicles.
Complementary parts of the same genealogy; together they form a complete overview of Israel's twelve sons.
